priorityList: Maintain Windfury Weapon, Flametongue Weapon, and Lightning Shield at all times.
Apply and maintain Flame Shock on your primary target if it is not ticking.
Cast Ascendance when Thorim's Invocation will trigger Chain Lightning.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racials during Ascendance or Doom Winds windows.
Cast Sundering if Surging Elements or Feral Spirit is talented.
Use Doom Winds on cooldown to maximize Windfury procs.
Cast Tempest when you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, unless both Ascendance and Doom Winds are active.
Cast Primordial Storm when you have 10 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
Cast Crash Lightning to maintain its cleave buff and as a high-priority generator.
Cast Windstrike (replaces Stormstrike during Ascendance) as your primary generator.
Cast Stormstrike while Doom Winds is active or if you have nearly full charges.
Spend Maelstrom Weapon stacks on Chain Lightning when at 9 or more stacks.
Cast Voltaic Blaze whenever the proc is available.
Cast Lava Lash as a filler when higher priority rotational abilities are on cooldown.
Cast Chain Lightning when at 5 or more stacks of Maelstrom Weapon to avoid overcapping.
